status: RESEARCH ONLY (forward paper collection from 2026-11-02; no news backtest exists, none is fabricated)
instruments: individual stocks only (SPY/QQQ excluded). Calls for an upward reaction, puts for a downward one. No shorting, no naked options, no new broker connection.

catalyst.eligible: catalysts.entry_eligible(): confirmed or attributed source, CONTENT VERIFIED by the desk's own fetch, not a resurfacing story
catalyst.why: company-specific (a headline naming more than 3 tickers is treated as market-wide); fresh enough that the reaction is still developing; a story the desk received more than 30 min after publication is flagged LATE because most of the move may already be gone

reaction.why: a real response is at least 1.5 five-minute ATRs from the price when the news arrived, on at least 2x the usual volume for those minutes (same minutes, prior 10 sessions); it must survive 10 minutes and keep at least half its gain (a spike that gave back over half is a spike, not momentum); beyond 6 ATRs the move is treated as exhausted

entry.confirm: a completed 1m candle closes beyond the prior completed 1m candle's extreme in the news direction, with the last 3 completed 1m closes on the news side of VWAP
entry.why: enter on a continuation close, not on the spike; at most 2 ATR5 from VWAP (anti-chasing); give up 60 min after the news

stop.initial: beyond the more conservative of VWAP and the last completed 5m candle's extreme, +/- 0.05 x ATR5

trail.method: best close since entry - 2 x ATR5 (calls; mirrored for puts)
trail.normal_vs_failure: a pullback that holds VWAP and stays above the trail is normal; a completed 5m close back through VWAP or a touch of the trail is momentum failure

exits_precedence: underlying stop/trail on the latest price
thresholds.dedupe: one entry per catalyst cluster per day; reposts and syndicated copies of one story share a cluster; a repost never restarts the age clock

latency_stats: share of the total move that happened before the desk received the news
